3
Wɔhyɛ ɔsom ase bio
1 # Esra 2.64 Na bosome a ɛtɔ so nson duruiɛ no, na Israelfoɔ no tete nkuro no mu, na ɔman no boaboaa wɔn ano yɛɛ sɛ nipa baako baa Yerusalem. 2#Esra 2.2; 1 Be 3.17-19; Eks 27.1; Lew 6.9 Na Yosadak ba Yesua ne ne nuanom asɔfoɔ no, ne Sealtiel ba Serubabel ne ne nuanom sɔree, na wɔkɔsii Israel Nyankopɔn afɔrebukyia sɛ wɔrebɔ so ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ no Nyankopɔn akoa Mose mmara mu no. 3Na wɔde afɔrebukyia no sii ne nnyinasoɔ so, ɛfiri sɛ nsase so aman ho hu kaa wɔn; na wɔbɔɔ so ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ maa AWURADE: Anɔpa hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne anwummerɛ deɛ. 4#Lew 23.34; Num 29.12-38 Na wɔdii asese nnapɔnna no sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ no, na wɔbɔɔ nna mfuamfua afɔdeɛ ne dodoɔ mu, sɛdeɛ mmara teɛ no, sɛdeɛ ɛhia da biara. 5Na ɛno akyiri no, wɔbɔɔ daa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, ne abosome foforɔ deɛ, ne AWURADE afahyɛ a wɔahyɛ no kronkron no nyinaa deɛ no ne wɔn a wɔde ayamyi adeɛ brɛɛ AWURADE no nyinaa deɛ nso. 6Bosome a ɛtɔ so nson no da a ɛdi kan no na wɔfirii AWURADE hyeɛ afɔdeɛ no bɔ aseɛ. Na AWURADE asɔredan no deɛ, na wɔnnya ntoo ne fapem. 7Na wɔde sika maa aboɔpaefoɔ ne nnua adwumfoɔ no, na wɔde aduane ne anonneɛ ne ngo maa Sidonfoɔ ne Tirofoɔ sɛ wɔnkɔfa ntweneduro nnua mfiri Lebanon nkɔ Yopa po ano, sɛdeɛ Persiahene Kores maa wɔn ho kwan no.
Asɔrefie no asehyɛ
8Na wɔbaa AWURADE fie ho wɔ Yerusalem afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu mu bosome a ɛtɔ so mmienu soɔ no, Sealtiel ba Serubabel ne Yosadak ba Yesua ne wɔn nuanom nkaeɛ, asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ ne wɔn a wɔfiri nnommumfa no mu baa Yerusalem no nyinaa firii aseɛ, na wɔde Lewifoɔ a wɔadi mfeɛ aduonu de rekorɔ no sisii hɔ sɛ wɔnhwɛ AWURADE fie adwuma no so. 9#Neh 10.9 Na Yesua ne ne mma ne ne nuanom, Kadmiel ne ne mma, Hodawia mma, gyinaa sɛ onipa koro sɛ wɔrehwɛ Nyankopɔn fie adwumayɛfoɔ no so: Henadad mma ne wɔn mma ne wɔn nuanom, Lewifoɔ nso ka wɔn ho.
10Na abantofoɔ no too AWURADE asɔredan no fapem no, asɔfoɔ a wɔahyehyɛ wɔn ntadeɛ kurakura ntotorobɛnto, ne Lewifoɔ, Asaf mma no, wɔkurakura nnawuro gyinagyina hɔ sɛ wɔreyi AWURADE ayɛ sɛdeɛ Israelhene Dawid hyehyɛeɛ no. 11#2 Be 5.13; 7.3; Dwom 118.1 Na wɔbuabuaa wɔn ho AWURADE ayeyie ne aseda no mu sɛ “ɔyɛ, na n’adɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa Israel so.” Na ɔman no nyinaa bɔɔ ose kɛseɛ AWURADE ayeyie no mu, sɛ wɔreto AWURADE fie fapem no nti. 12#Hag 2.3 Na asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ ne agyanom atitire no mu pii a wɔanyini, a wɔhunuu akane fie no, wɔtoo fapem no wɔ wɔn anim no, wɔde nne kɛseɛ sui, na nnipa pii nso maa wɔn nne so osebɔ ne anigyeɛ mu, 13na ɔman no anhunu anigyeɛ sebɔ gyegyeegye ne ɔman no su gyegyeegye no ntam nsonsonoeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔman no bɔɔ ose kɛseɛ maa wɔtee gyegyeegye no akyirikyiri.

Na bosome a ɛtɔ so nson duruiɛ no, na Israelfoɔ no tete nkuro no mu, na ɔman no boaboaa wɔn ano yɛɛ sɛ nipa baako baa Yerusalem. Na Yosadak ba Yesua ne ne nuanom asɔfoɔ no, ne Sealtiel ba Serubabel ne ne nuanom sɔree, na wɔkɔsii Israel Nyankopɔn afɔrebukyia sɛ wɔrebɔ so ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ no Nyankopɔn akoa Mose mmara mu no. Na wɔde afɔrebukyia no sii ne nnyinasoɔ so, ɛfiri sɛ nsase so aman ho hu kaa wɔn; na wɔbɔɔ so ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ maa AWURADE: Anɔpa hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne anwummerɛ deɛ. Na wɔdii asese nnapɔnna no sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ no, na wɔbɔɔ nna mfuamfua afɔdeɛ ne dodoɔ mu, sɛdeɛ mmara teɛ no, sɛdeɛ ɛhia da biara. Na ɛno akyiri no, wɔbɔɔ daa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, ne abosome foforɔ deɛ, ne AWURADE afahyɛ a wɔahyɛ no kronkron no nyinaa deɛ no ne wɔn a wɔde ayamyi adeɛ brɛɛ AWURADE no nyinaa deɛ nso. Bosome a ɛtɔ so nson no da a ɛdi kan no na wɔfirii AWURADE hyeɛ afɔdeɛ no bɔ aseɛ. Na AWURADE asɔredan no deɛ, na wɔnnya ntoo ne fapem. Na wɔde sika maa aboɔpaefoɔ ne nnua adwumfoɔ no, na wɔde aduane ne anonneɛ ne ngo maa Sidonfoɔ ne Tirofoɔ sɛ wɔnkɔfa ntweneduro nnua mfiri Lebanon nkɔ Yopa po ano, sɛdeɛ Persiahene Kores maa wɔn ho kwan no.

Na wɔbaa AWURADE fie ho wɔ Yerusalem afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu mu bosome a ɛtɔ so mmienu soɔ no, Sealtiel ba Serubabel ne Yosadak ba Yesua ne wɔn nuanom nkaeɛ, asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ ne wɔn a wɔfiri nnommumfa no mu baa Yerusalem no nyinaa firii aseɛ, na wɔde Lewifoɔ a wɔadi mfeɛ aduonu de rekorɔ no sisii hɔ sɛ wɔnhwɛ AWURADE fie adwuma no so. Na Yesua ne ne mma ne ne nuanom, Kadmiel ne ne mma, Hodawia mma, gyinaa sɛ onipa koro sɛ wɔrehwɛ Nyankopɔn fie adwumayɛfoɔ no so: Henadad mma ne wɔn mma ne wɔn nuanom, Lewifoɔ nso ka wɔn ho.
Na abantofoɔ no too AWURADE asɔredan no fapem no, asɔfoɔ a wɔahyehyɛ wɔn ntadeɛ kurakura ntotorobɛnto, ne Lewifoɔ, Asaf mma no, wɔkurakura nnawuro gyinagyina hɔ sɛ wɔreyi AWURADE ayɛ sɛdeɛ Israelhene Dawid hyehyɛeɛ no. Na wɔbuabuaa wɔn ho AWURADE ayeyie ne aseda no mu sɛ “ɔyɛ, na n’adɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa Israel so.” Na ɔman no nyinaa bɔɔ ose kɛseɛ AWURADE ayeyie no mu, sɛ wɔreto AWURADE fie fapem no nti. Na asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ ne agyanom atitire no mu pii a wɔanyini, a wɔhunuu akane fie no, wɔtoo fapem no wɔ wɔn anim no, wɔde nne kɛseɛ sui, na nnipa pii nso maa wɔn nne so osebɔ ne anigyeɛ mu, na ɔman no anhunu anigyeɛ sebɔ gyegyeegye ne ɔman no su gyegyeegye no ntam nsonsonoeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔman no bɔɔ ose kɛseɛ maa wɔtee gyegyeegye no akyirikyiri.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
